source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1]
    separators = {grid[i][0] for i in rows} | {grid[0][j] for j in cols}
    values = [v for row in grid for v in row if v not in separators]
    background = Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_edges = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    col_edges = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_edges) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_edges[ri] + 1, row_edges[ri + 1]
        line = []
        for ci in range(len(col_edges) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_edges[ci] + 1, col_edges[ci + 1]
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            line.append(1 if count == 2 else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
